package.name: cyton_trac_ik_kinematics_plugin
package.description: MoveIt2-native TRAC-IK kinematics plugin for the Cyton Gamma 1500, wrapping a vendored, modified copy of trac_ik_lib's core solver (third_party/trac_ik_lib, see its own README.md) behind a fresh implementation of MoveIt2's kinematics::KinematicsBase interface -- built to A/B compare against the KDL plugin already used by cyton_moveit_config. Not a port of the original ROS1/catkin trac_ik_kinematics_plugin package (that one depends on roscpp/tf_conversions/the ROS1 parameter server, none of which exist here); see the plugin header's own comment for the full explanation.
